enforced: asset roles are closed (schema enum + semantic validator)
link targets are routes, anchors or dest:<role> (never a literal live URL)
convention: token references in prose guidance (README, section purpose)
overrides: NOT AVAILABLE. A PageSpec node carries only {section, variant, content, motion}; there is no per-instance style/token override field. Styling is owned entirely by section/component contracts, so there is nothing to validate or mutate at the PageSpec layer (MASTER-GUIDE 3.21). Drift of the catalog/policy against real token files is checked in extraction/verify_all.py instead.
